title: Endings
scope: What happens when a run reaches green: the pull request, what the human reads, who decides, and what is cleaned up. Excludes the run log's role in the next attempt (see iteration-and-failure-axes).

statements.statement: the build workflow runs, if green and review passes it ends a PR is opened. I am informed and I read the reports check stuff out (I don't just look at the PR). if happy I merge, if not a fill in runlog and try again. reject PR delete branch.
statements.context: Answering how a run should end, after the interviewer invented a command for it.

statements.statement: workflow can clean up worktrees etc.
statements.context: Same turn, on who does the cleanup.

statements.statement: human does not gate the waves.
statements.context: Correcting a drafted behaviour that had the human clearing every wave.

statements.statement: basically all human after that. final gate is to start again or merge. the other two you have correct plan and interfaces.
statements.context: Same answer, pointing at the endings guide in the source for where the human takes over.

statements.statement: I commit before I strip, this keep the docs creation history. but I have another domain. Endings. I assume the command surface is big here and that is a problem. pretty sure the agent wrote the runlog, not sure if that is handled in the system?
statements.context: Asked what happens to a run's interview residue before the run closes.
